name: Metaphysics
overview: Scripture reveals the foundational reality of God's unique and incomparable nature, affirming that He alone is God and sovereign over all (Isaiah 46:9). The eternal Word, who was with God and is God, underscores the divine nature that transcends the physical (John 1:1). God's invisible attributes, including His eternal power and divine nature, are clearly perceived through creation, leaving humanity without excuse (Romans 1:20). Believers are called to a transformed mind that discerns God's perfect will, emphasizing a spiritual renewal that aligns with God's truth beyond worldly understanding (Romans 12:2; Matthew 6:22).
